# Ryan Burke

> Ryan Burke is a software engineer, film photographer, oil pastel painter, basketball junkie, and twenty-handicap golfer. Also: sushi enjoyer, Morir Soñando drinker, chai consumer, Birkenstocks owner, Frank Ocean listener, and Diddy Kong main. This is Ryan's personal site.

## About

Ryan is a senior software engineer living on the US east coast who architects thoughtfully-designed software systems. Outside of work: basketball, film photography, oil pastels, golf (not well), and chilling out with Ryan's dog and wife.

- [About](https://rburke.dev/#about)

## Experience

### Senior Software Engineer at DealerOn (Feb 2021 – Present)

Tech: .NET, C#, Azure, SQL Server, RabbitMQ, Redis, Claude

Architects dealership websites, CMS tools, and backend systems for 4,000+ dealers across North America.

#### Professional summary (on the site, click Bean, Ryan's 8-bit dog, under the DealerOn job)

Senior Software Engineer with nearly six years of experience designing scalable distributed systems and cloud-native applications. At DealerOn, Ryan helps build a greenfield website editor and rendering platform, co-led the split of the company's largest monolith into six independently owned services, and led the migration of its mission-critical Leads platform to three deployable services. He focuses on reliable architecture, clear service contracts, and mentoring engineers.

Senior Software Engineer (Oct 2025 – present):

- Develop a greenfield drag-and-drop page editor and rendering platform that lets automotive dealerships build, customize, and publish websites, working across frontend, backend, and cross-service integrations.
- Design versioned API and data contracts for an extensible widget architecture, allowing other teams to integrate independently developed components through shared NuGet packages while preserving backward compatibility.
- Improve frontend performance and reliability with non-blocking CSS, client-side caching, Grafana dashboards, and automated alerts.

Software Engineer (Feb 2021 – Oct 2025):

- Co-led the decomposition of the company's largest monolith into six independently owned services, defining service boundaries, data migration strategies, and CI/CD workflows while coordinating work across engineering teams.
- Led the Leads platform migration to three independently deployable microservices using incremental migration, isolated databases, and durable RabbitMQ messaging.
- Improved platform uptime to 99.7% and reduced severity incidents by 30% through service isolation, fault-tolerant messaging, retry policies, and graceful degradation.
- Served as a technical subject matter expert for architecture decisions, design reviews, technical roadmaps, and code reviews, while mentoring fellow engineers.

Technical skills:

- Languages: C#, SQL, TypeScript
- Frameworks: .NET, .NET Aspire, Vue.js
- Cloud & infrastructure: Microsoft Azure, Docker, Redis, FusionCache
- Messaging: RabbitMQ, MassTransit
- Architecture & practices: Microservices, distributed systems, REST APIs, SQL Server, database design, CI/CD, resilience patterns

### IT Technician at University of Maryland, Division of IT (Sept 2019 – Jan 2021)

College gig installing, diagnosing, and repairing hardware and software for students and staff.
